name: 2027 Option 4 — Quality core and in-house capability
assumptions: Equal weight per need. Full-course assessment evidence; course completion is not competency sign-off. Budgets exclude internal practice. Shared learning is inherited once. Planning year 2027. Curated proposal, not an optimisation claim. Original v8 scores unchanged. Full-course study times; TR-118 full RMF/Playbook/Profile bundle has an open-ended 4h+ duration, so 6h is a labelled planner estimate subject to pilot. Internal hours are learner estimates and do not increase assessed coverage. Primary Practitioner labs need basic Python or coached support. Quality means syllabus/assessment evidence and role fit, not proven learner effectiveness. Full-catalogue access remains available; recommendation exclusions enforce this shortlist until a head changes them. Planning duration corrections: TR-158 1h30 means 1.5h; TR-155 official four-module path totals 9h26m (566/60 hours), superseding the catalogue 8h metadata for planning only. TR-159 combines several lab collections and has no total duration, so exclude from auto-selection until scoped. These do not alter assessment scores. Explicit minute durations for INT-271, INT-275, INT-276, INT-340, INT-452, INT-476 and INT-1473 are retained using overrides because the app parser currently treats their parenthesised lecture counts as ambiguous; no content-based score changes. MCP server construction is an Expert addition. Broad all-Practitioner core is Evaluating AI Agents plus CSA agentic controls, with bank Skill/connector practice. Generic governance, guardrail and coding-awareness supplements are optional rather than mandatory where they add no scored need coverage. Global curriculum: nationally framed guidance is not assigned as common training. TR-125, TR-128 and TR-129 are excluded; globally applicable technical frameworks are retained. Jurisdiction-specific obligations belong in relevant local-role supplements, with separate time allowances. Targeted in-house modules teach the actual work, platforms, controls and operating model. The N14 workflow workshop replaces INT-2478 in the Expert and leadership paths. Planned internal coverage is unassessed; it never adds points to course coverage. Foundation internal learning is 4h; Practitioner internal learning is 8h; Technical Expert 12h; Governance Expert 8h; Leadership 6h; specialists 4h. Expert pathways are alternatives. Development effort is separate from learner time.

cohorts.name: All users

internal.title: IH-01 · What our people are doing with AI
internal.owner: Cyber AI adoption lead + champions from all six functions
internal.outcomes: 10m orientation; 35m two colleague-led case demonstrations including a failure and its correction; 15m an emerging or restricted-pilot demonstration; 15m domain application; 15m knowledge check and reflection. Use a short case gallery to represent all six functions without six separate lectures. Evidence: N1.1: explain one own-domain and one neighbouring-domain use case, including limitations. N1.2: distinguish production, restricted pilot and horizon examples. N1.3: propose two or three changes to own work and identify retained human accountability.

internal.title: IH-02 · Our approved tools, agent architecture and boundaries
internal.owner: AI platform owner + IAM + IDP + security architecture
internal.outcomes: 25m model, modality and agent walkthrough; 25m approved platforms, data flow and connector permissions; 20m approval, logs and stop controls; 20m access/data-boundary decisions. Use one real approved architecture with a simplified diagram. Evidence: Label model, harness, tools and controls; select the permitted platform for a data class; distinguish available access from a pilot; locate the correct approval, stop and escalation route.

internal.title: IH-03 · Safe use in my job — coached case and Gate 1
internal.outcomes: 15m coached case; 30m individual safe-use scenario; 15m feedback. Use approved or synthetic data and a task representative of the learner’s function. Evidence: Reject an unsafe data/tool choice, detect a planted unsupported claim or injection, verify the output and record accountability. Safety-critical decisions must pass.

cohorts.rationale: Curated syllabus selection; no optimality claim.
cohorts.note: Foundation and Entry practice. N1–N6 at Base / Entry scope.

cohorts.name: Practitioner additions

internal.title: IH-04 · Supervise and recover an agent on our platform
internal.owner: Domain operations owner + AI platform team
internal.outcomes: 30m workflow and permissions; 60m trace-review and planted-error lab; 30m stop, revoke, rollback and manual-fallback exercise. Evidence: Delegate within an approved action class, inspect permissions and changes, identify planted failures, stop/revoke safely and produce an accountable handover.

internal.title: IH-05 · Create, own and retire a shared Skill
internal.owner: Domain automation champion + Skill-library owner + IAM
internal.outcomes: 30m worked example and third-party vetting; 60m create a focused Skill and safe connector specification; 30m peer review, ownership, monthly review and deprecation. Evidence: Submit a trigger, steps, expected output, failure modes and tests; name an owner and review/deprecation rule; justify connector permissions and provenance.

internal.title: IH-06 · Domain test cases and release checks
internal.outcomes: 30m independent answers and known faults; 60m build and run five representative cases with pass/fail checks; 30m simulate a model/Skill change and submit results to the domain evaluation process. Evidence: Versioned cases, known faults and acceptance checks; rerun record; contribution to the shared domain evidence store.

internal.title: IH-07 · Agent-supervisor observed sign-off
internal.outcomes: 75m observed task with injected faults and a connector change; 30m independent challenge; 15m feedback and scope-of-authority record. Evidence: Pass each safety-critical action and justify an evidence-based release decision. Record permitted action classes and any remediation.

cohorts.rationale: Curated syllabus selection; no optimality claim.
cohorts.note: Includes third-party Skill / connector vetting introduced at Practitioner.

cohorts.name: Technical Expert

internal.title: IH-08T · Workflow and supervision design studio

internal.outcomes: 45m map current work; 60m redesign tasks and approval points; 45m review evaluation evidence and supervision load; 30m agree measures and ownership. Evidence: An approved before/after workflow, human/agent task split, supervision ratio hypothesis, autonomy limits supported by evaluation, value baseline, owner and refresh plan.

internal.title: IH-09T · Build, evaluate and secure a scoped agent
internal.owner: AI engineering + AppSec + domain evaluation lead
internal.outcomes: 2h configure an existing approved scaffold; 2h tests and human-label calibration; 2h attack, recovery and production-monitoring rehearsal; 1h evidence dossier. Reuse one project across the pathway. Evidence: Versioned implementation and test cases, human-checked judge results, working controls, attack/recovery trace, monitoring and ownership record.

internal.title: IH-10T · Independent technical challenge
internal.outcomes: 75m reproduce an unseen failure and recovery; 30m design/evidence challenge; 15m feedback and permitted-scope record. Evidence: Reproducible test evidence and pass on all critical controls within the authorised action class.

cohorts.rationale: Use specialist external teaching, with an internal workshop for actual workflow allocation, autonomy, supervision and adoption. INT-2478 is replaced; its assessed coverage is not transferred.
